title: quant-kernel: improve INT8/FP8 kernels and add smoothquant + dequant-fusion fast path
author: Avery Chen
description: Summary: This PR implements a high-throughput fast path for quantized transformer inference combining INT8 and FP8 execution kernels with SmoothQuant-style weight/input scaling and an explicit dequant-fusion optimization. Motivation: production workloads are increasingly using quantized model variants for lower cost; however, we observed that the runtime overhead from per-layer dequant/quant round trips plus scale adjustments erodes expected throughput improvements. This change reduces operator churn and kernel launch overhead by fusing dequantization with the GEMM/attention kernels where safe, adds a SmoothQuant-compatible scaling pass that is applied at load/compile time for compatible models, and introduces specialized INT8/FP8 micro-kernels with optimized memory layout and precomputed scale factors. Key changes: - Compiler/runtime: new quant-fusion pass that detects dequant + matmul + requant patterns and replaces them with fused kernels. - Kernels: INT8/FP8 GEMM and attention kernels with packed weight layout and precomputed reciprocal scale vectors. - KV-cache: KV cache update path modified to avoid extra dequant/requant when caching is used; adds a lightweight type-tag to cache entries to select fused path. - Batching/scheduling: continuous-batching scheduler now prefers fused-kernel-capable workers when request distribution has high quantized usage to improve packing. - Safety: runtime falls back to existing unfused path for models that touch unsupported ops or have dynamic scaling ranges. Benchmarks: on internal opt-1.3B quantized evaluation sets we see ~1.6x throughput and ~18-22% median latency improvement at batch sizes 1-8 and memory reduction on peak GPU memory of ~12%. See ci benchmark logs attached. Backwards compatibility: non-breaking; models continue to work on unfused path. Rollout: gated behind a feature flag (quant_fusion_enable) and enabled by default for models annotated in the model catalog as "quant-friendly". Related: ENG-9876 (quant rollout), ENG-10012 (kv cache perf).
commits_summary: 6 commits: initial fused-kernel prototype; add smoothquant loader pass; implement INT8/FP8 GEMM kernels; integrate fused kernels into runtime dispatcher; KV-cache tagging and fast-path selection; tests and benchmarks added.
review_comments: Luis Garcia: Please ensure the fused kernel has numerically-identical outputs within epsilon for all supported scales; provide unit tests for rounding behavior.
Avery Chen (author): Added per-layer unit tests and explicit epsilon asserts; documented known tiny diffs when using FP8 dynamic exponents.
Maria Novak: Can we avoid extra branching in the hot-path selection? Consider a worker-local capability bitmap instead of runtime checks on each request.
Avery Chen (author): Reworked scheduler integration to use worker capability bitmap and added microbenchmarks; removed per-request dispatch branch.
Tomoko Ishikawa: CI benchmarks look promising; please add a canary rollout plan for Dedicated pools to validate at scale.
Avery Chen (author): Added rollout plan to docs and feature flag gating; plan includes 1% then 10% capacity ramps for Dedicated pools.
release_notes: Add fused INT8/FP8 kernels and SmoothQuant-compatible loader pass; enable quantized dequant-fusion fast path behind feature flag quant_fusion_enable; improvements: ~1.6x throughput and ~20% latency reduction for quantized models. See docs/quant-fusion.md for rollout and safety notes.
notes: Feature gated; default enabled for model-catalog annotated models. Ops coverage matrix added to docs.
